Inquiry hears of 'horrific' disabilities from disgraced surgeon's operations

An inquiry has been told that patients suffered 'horrific' disabilities following surgeries performed by disgraced surgeon Sam Eljamel. Public hearings for the Eljamel Inquiry are described as 'a long time coming' by senior counsel. Victims of Eljamel's procedures are seeking answers from the inquiry, according to an ex-Member of the Scottish Parliament who supported campaigners. The coverage focuses on the testimonies and the progress of the inquiry into the surgeon's past actions.
